text_blocks.snippet: Inflation is an increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time. It means that your money buys less than it used to, effectively decreasing your purchasing power.
snippet_highlighted_words: an increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time

list.title: General Price Increase:
list.snippet: Inflation isn't just about one or two items becoming more expensive. It's a broad trend affecting the overall cost of a wide range of goods and services.

list.title: Decreased Purchasing Power:
list.snippet: As prices rise, the same amount of money buys fewer things, meaning your money's value decreases.
